description: Regione Toscana - Frane IFFI is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by www502.regione.toscana.it. In the context of the IFFI Convention (Inventory of the Italian Fenomeni Franosi) between ISPRA and Regione Toscana, a collaboration has been activated between the IFFI project contacts and the officials of the sectors in charge of the Tuscany region and the LaMMA Consortium, aimed at updating the landslides of the Tuscan territory published on ... Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Region of Tuscany — Frane IFFI" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include RNDT, opendata. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
